meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你把电脑上的 OpenClaw 机器人迁移到 NanoClaw v2：先查找安装，再逐步确认要迁移的身份、聊天群、凭据和定时任务等，最后应用更改。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from openclaw”“openclaw migration”或“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 帮我从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: Claude 会开始检测你的 OpenClaw 安装。

say.text: 迁移我的 OpenClaw 配置和定时任务
say.note: Claude 会读取配置并和你确认要迁移的内容。

say.text: 导入 OpenClaw 的聊天记录
say.note: Claude 会查找聊天数据并询问如何放置。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you migrate an existing OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2. It detects the installation, walks you through what to keep (identity, groups, credentials, scheduled tasks), then applies the changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Help me migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: Claude will start by detecting your OpenClaw installation.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw config and scheduled tasks
say_en.note: Claude will read the config and confirm what to migrate.
Claude will look for chat data and ask how to place it.
